title: stream-json stream carries raw Bash stdout and stderr

fixtures.name: stream-json: env-sourced secret printed to stdout and stderr (runner must use --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-hook-events; no schema field for flags or process env, so secret is placed in files)

files.print.sh:
set -a; . ./.env; set +a
printenv DEMO_TOKEN
echo FAKESECRET_abc123 >&2
